title: EventBus unregister during callback chain contract

contract.callback_chain_unregister: A listener can unregister a later listener while the current callback chain is executing
contract.immediate_delivery_effect: A listener removed before its delivery turn is reached does not receive the active event
contract.delivery_order: Listeners that remain registered continue in their existing registration order
contract.registry_update: The unregister operation immediately removes the target listener from the registry
contract.remaining_listener_preservation: Unrelated listeners remain registered and continue receiving events
contract.subsequent_delivery: The removed listener does not receive subsequent events
contract.registry_stability: Unregister during callback execution does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after callback-chain unregister
contract.permission_enforcement: Unregister and emit operations require the events permission
